requirements.requirement: Projection-backed operational surfaces must expose trust state, last updated time, degraded/stale reason when not current, and whether actions are partially gated.
requirements.evidence: Every projection-backed operational surface should expose at least trust state, last updated time, degraded/stale reason, and partial action gating.

requirements.requirement: Refreshing states should continue showing last committed projection instead of blanking the page.
requirements.evidence: 'refreshing' should continue showing the last committed projection rather than blanking the page.

requirements.requirement: UI must never silently present stale operational truth as live truth.
requirements.evidence: The system should never quietly present stale operational truth as if it were live truth.

requirements.requirement: Historical run mode must visibly indicate focused historical run across tabs and gate live-only controls.
requirements.evidence: Required behavior lists persistent historical banner/chip, visible focused historical run_id, and disabling/removing active-run-only controls.

requirements.requirement: All Orchestrator tabs should share one focused run_id to prevent context drift.
requirements.evidence: Strong recommendation says all Orchestrator tabs share the same focused run_id.

decisions.decision: Adopt explicit separation between active run truth and focused run context.
decisions.rationale: Prevents conflation of currently running state with user-inspected historical context.

decisions.decision: Introduce first-class Historical Run Mode in Orchestrator.
decisions.rationale: Needed to define stable behavior, action gating, and user awareness when inspecting non-active runs.

decisions.decision: Do not auto-switch user focus from historical run to live run when new activity appears.
decisions.rationale: Avoids unstable UX and unintentional context replacement.

decisions.decision: Persist per-project Orchestrator focus state in a dedicated project-state record.
decisions.rationale: Current persistence support appears underspecified for run focus/restore behavior.

routing_rules.rule: In historical mode, route actions only when historical-safe; disable live-runtime mutating commands.
examples: historical-safe: inspect graph/evidence/ledger, export, view lineage
disable: pause/resume/cancel, live retry/remediation, approval/recovery requiring current runtime truth

routing_rules.rule: If active run appears while user views history, keep historical focus and offer explicit switch-to-live notice.
Cross-tab navigation must preserve focused run_id so History, Graph, Evidence, and Ledger remain coherent.
examples: History selection pivots entire page run context

verification_rules.rule: Projection-backed surfaces always show trust and freshness metadata.
verification_rules.check: Each relevant tab/widget renders trust state and last updated, plus stale/degraded reason when applicable.

verification_rules.rule: Refreshing does not blank previously committed projection.
verification_rules.check: During refresh transitions, last committed view remains visible.

verification_rules.rule: Historical mode clearly signaled and live-only controls gated.
verification_rules.check: Persistent historical indicator present; live-only controls disabled/hidden.

verification_rules.rule: Focus stability is preserved across background/live updates.
verification_rules.check: A new active run does not forcibly replace historical focus; explicit switch path is shown.
History -> Node Graph -> Evidence -> Ledger remain aligned on same focused run_id.

stale_retirement_items.item: Retire ad-hoc, surface-specific stale handling by introducing one reusable projection health/trust UI contract.

stale_retirement_items.item: Retire implicit or silent live-vs-historical context switching.
stale_retirement_items.why: Explicit historical mode and focus persistence are needed to prevent ambiguous state.

stale_retirement_items.item: Retire blank-on-refresh rendering behavior where present.
